2026_02_CIN_HOU.headline: Houston’s improved run game challenges Cincinnati’s road discipline
2026_02_CIN_HOU.paragraph1: Cincinnati takes its first road trip after an opening win, while Houston is trying to convert an encouraging offensive debut into a better result. The Bengals’ scouting report highlights David Montgomery’s expanded role and the Texans’ defensive front, and Houston’s own recap points to a more promising ground game and C.J. Stroud spreading the ball around. Cincinnati must prevent Houston from staying comfortably ahead of the sticks; the Texans need their offense to finish the drives that were not enough against Buffalo.
2026_02_CIN_HOU.model_rationale: Houston’s run-game efficiency and Cincinnati’s ability to create passing downs determine whether the Texans can keep C.J. Stroud comfortable or the Bengals can expose the protection.
